business_problem: To build a data infrastructure capable of supporting advanced machine learning calculations without expanding operational overhead, RIA Catalyst migrated its user interface layer to a decoupled Next.js web application architecture.
solution_summary: RIA Catalyst paired AlloyDB Omni and Cloud Run to process complex regulatory data, transforming wealth management mergers and acquisitions processes with real-time machine learning. RIA Catalyst , a disruptive mergers and acquisitions software platform headquartered in Dallas, Texas, operates at the specialized intersection of wealth management intelligence and machine learning technology. The startup provides predictive sourcing resources for large registered investment advisors managing upwards of 100 billion dollars in assets under management, alongside institutional private equity groups executing strategic sector consolidations. When the company first launched, the engineering group constructed a basic minimum viable product by piping structured datasets straight from BigQuery into a standard, out-of-the-box PowerBI visualization interface.
